name: Salesforce
tagline: Dense enterprise UI — objects, tabs, setup. Notoriously steep.
firstWin: your Sales home with a first lead or contact created
path: make sure the Sales app is selected (App Launcher, top left)
open the Leads or Contacts tab
use the New button to create your first record
save and view it on the record page
optional: Customising fields and page layouts lives in Setup (gear icon) — a later step.

knowledge.text: The App Launcher is the grid/waffle icon, top-left. Use it to switch between apps like Sales, Service, and Marketing.
Leads and Contacts each have a New button on their list view (top-right) to create a record. A Lead is an unqualified prospect; a Contact belongs to an Account.
Setup (the gear icon, top-right) is where you customise objects, fields, and layouts — separate from day-to-day record work.
